# GymCrush

> GymCrush is an iOS fitness app for couples with shared daily challenges, one shared streak, and workout photos for each other.

Status: Coming soon; not yet live on the App Store. Platform: iOS. Language: US English. Official website: https://getgymcrush.com/.

## Verified product features

- Both partners get the same daily challenges and share one streak.
- Partner pushes report completed workouts, moments, dares, dare outcomes, and chosen stakes.
- Team Assist merges both partners’ daily goals into one bar; a streak freeze is available.
- Stakes are bets on the shared streak. Partners can send dares and moments (workout photos).
- A lock-screen widget shows the partner’s photo.
- Couples hatch mascots from Mascot Balls and have a 90-day reward path.
- Annual subscription with a 3-day trial; no price is stated here.

## Practical guides

- [18 Couple Workout Challenges to Try Together](https://getgymcrush.com/couple-workout-challenges): Choose from 18 couple workout challenges, set fair rules, and build a sample week with walking, dancing, strength, and quieter options.
- [How to Invite Your Boyfriend to Work Out With You](https://getgymcrush.com/get-boyfriend-to-work-out): A practical way to invite your boyfriend to work out: clear scripts, choices for common obstacles, and a one-week experiment you both agree to.
- [Working Out Together at Different Fitness Levels](https://getgymcrush.com/different-fitness-levels): Plan a couples workout at different fitness levels with separate targets, a shared finish time, and examples for walking, classes, and the gym.
- [A 12-Week Wedding Workout Plan for Couples](https://getgymcrush.com/wedding-workout-plan): A flexible 12-week wedding workout planning framework with a sample week, separate goals, rest days, and ways to handle busy wedding weeks.
- [Long-Distance Couple Workouts: A Practical Weekly Plan](https://getgymcrush.com/long-distance-couple-workouts): Plan long-distance couple workouts with three schedule options, a time-zone worksheet, a sample week, and simple check-in messages.
- [12 Gym Date Ideas for Couples](https://getgymcrush.com/gym-date-ideas): Twelve gym date ideas with preparation tips, a simple date itinerary, and alternatives for different fitness levels or crowded gyms.
- [A 30-Day Couples Fitness Challenge Calendar](https://getgymcrush.com/30-day-couples-fitness-challenge): A complete 30-day couples fitness challenge with activity choices, rest days, weekly reviews, and a simple way to restart after a missed day.
- [Accountability Partner Apps: A Couples Selection Guide](https://getgymcrush.com/accountability-partner-apps): Choose an accountability partner app using a practical checklist, four tool types, a seven-day trial scorecard, and a shared-note fallback.
- [Best Couple Workout Apps: Choose by How You Train](https://getgymcrush.com/best-couple-workout-apps): Compare Hevy, Strava, and Apple Fitness+ by verified sharing and workout features, plus a clearly labeled upcoming couples fitness app.
- [A Weekly Couple Workout Planner You Can Copy](https://getgymcrush.com/weekly-couple-workout-planner): Copy a weekly couple workout planner with separate plans, shared appointments, fallback options, and a five-minute Sunday review.

These guides contain original planning suggestions, separate from the app’s features. No weight-loss results, body outcomes, user counts, ratings, or customer testimonials are claimed.
